title: Rayman 2: The Great Escape
shortDescription: Rayman 2: The Great Escape is included in GameAtlas's Nintendo 64 platformer route, alongside deterministic catalog context and a linked Wikidata item.
highlights: Places a source-linked platformer entry in the Nintendo 64 browsing path.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Nintendo 64 platformer discovery path using the preserved Wikidata entity record; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
